services.name: Pattern blouses

services.headline: A little detail. A whole new expression.
services.intro: A blouse can change the way a saree feels. Bring your fabric, a reference or simply an idea, and talk to us about a pattern that suits your style.

details.title: Start with your saree
details.text: Share the colour, texture and occasion. These details help guide a neckline, sleeve style and overall design that work together.

details.title: Make the pattern personal
details.text: Discuss front and back neck shapes, sleeve lengths and the amount of detail you would like. Bring reference images to explain the look you have in mind.

details.title: Plan your appointment
details.text: Contact the boutique to discuss your fabric, measurements and required date. Your final design, quote and timeline can be confirmed directly during consultation.

faq.question: Can I share a reference blouse design?
faq.answer: Yes. Send your reference images on WhatsApp so the boutique can discuss how the pattern could work with your fabric and preferences.

faq.question: How do I enquire about a pattern blouse?
faq.answer: Share your name, fabric or saree details, the design you have in mind and your required date. The boutique will discuss the next steps with you directly.

details.title: Find your neckline
details.text: Tell us how structured or soft you want the design to feel. Discuss the neck shape alongside your saree, jewellery and occasion.

details.title: Balance the details
details.text: Sleeves, back design and decorative elements should feel considered together. Share your inspiration and preferences during your consultation.

details.title: Discuss the fit
details.text: Contact the boutique to arrange measurement and fitting details. Confirm your event date early so the boutique can advise on availability.

faq.question: Can a high-neck blouse be customised for an occasion?
faq.answer: Yes. Discuss the occasion, saree, neckline and detailing you have in mind with the boutique to plan a personalised design.
